info.name: Lab Onboarding (Complete Flow)
info.description:
Full self-registration flow: verification email -> token -> complete onboarding -> login -> lab documents (S3).

HOW TO RUN
1. Set {{baseUrl}}, {{email}} (a real inbox you can read), {{username}} and {{password}} (min 8 chars) in the collection variables.
2. Folder 1: "Request verification email". Open the email, copy the `token` query param from the link into {{verificationToken}}.
3. Folder 2: run "Complete onboarding - FULL" (or "MINIMAL"). The verification token is single-use; a successful submit consumes it, so request a new email for every successful run. The additional-field validation failures (400 cases) are rejected before the token is consumed, so they can be re-run with the same token.
4. Folder 3: "Login" captures {{accessToken}}. Folder 4 then uses it with the labId captured in step 2.

Context path /api/v1 is included in each request path. Folders 1-2 are public; folders 3-4 send `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.
The new onboarding fields (organization, compliance, terms) are all optional, so MINIMAL (existing fields only) still works unchanged.

request.description: POST /public/onboarding/request-verification - sends the verification link. Max 3 emails per hour per email. Copy the `token` from the link into {{verificationToken}}.
Same logic and same rate limit as request-verification.

item.name: Verify email token (GET, as in the email link)

request.description: GET /public/onboarding/verify-email?token= - checks the token (does not consume it) and returns the frontend onboarding redirectUrl.
POST /public/onboarding/validate-token?token= - JSON variant; does not consume the token.

request.description:
POST /public/onboarding/complete - creates the SUPERADMIN user and the lab with organization, compliance and terms fields. 201 on success; labId is captured into {{labId}}. Consumes the verification token.

All 5 file URL fields (labLogo, gstinCertificate, establishmentRegistrationCertificate, biomedicalWasteAuthorizationCertificate, nablAccreditationCertificate) are optional strings; placeholder URLs are used here. In real use, upload the files with the Lab documents endpoints after login (Add fails with 400 for a document that already has a URL - use Update instead).

labAddressLine2/labDistrict are blank on purpose: with sameAsOrganizationAddress=true they are copied from the organization. labPan/labGstin are omitted: with the same-as-organization flags they are copied from the organization.

request.description: POST /public/login with the account created in step 2.

item.name: Get lab by id (verify stored onboarding fields)

request.description: Verifies the lab created during onboarding.

GET /lab/admin/{labId}/documents - returns the stored S3 URL for labLogo, gstinCertificate, establishmentRegistrationCertificate, biomedicalWasteAuthorizationCertificate and nablAccreditationCertificate (null when not uploaded). The same URLs are also returned by the Add / Update calls.

POST /lab/admin/{labId}/documents (multipart). Pick a file for each part (PDF/PNG/JPEG, < 1 MB; logo must be PNG/JPEG). All-or-nothing; 400 if a document already exists (use PUT). If the lab was onboarded with the FULL body, the BMW certificate already holds a placeholder URL, so use Update for that one instead of Add.
Any subset of the 5 part names is allowed.
PUT replaces documents that already exist; old S3 files are deleted only after the DB commit. 400 if a document does not exist yet.
DELETE /lab/admin/{labId}/documents?types=... - clears the URL; the S3 object is deleted after commit.

item.name: Add - valid file + invalid file (expect 400, nothing saved)

request.description: Pick a valid PDF/PNG/JPEG for gstinCertificate and a .txt/.docx for nablAccreditationCertificate. Validation fails before any upload, so gstinCertificate must not be saved either.
Run when the document has not been added yet.

item.name: Delete - one existing + one missing (expect 400, nothing deleted)

request.description: Use when one of the two is empty: the whole request is rejected and the existing one is kept.
